summary: Tested new tour-level inventory feature (backend + frontend). Backend APIs work on preview URL after environment recovery (mongod + backend supervisor had to be started, python deps installed). Frontend /admin/inventory CRASHES due to a React ReferenceError: 'TourInventoryManagement is not defined' in AdminDashboard.js — the component is used in a Route but never imported (only InventoryManagement is imported from the barrel).
passed: Admin login via UI succeeds and redirects to /admin dashboard

failed.issue: Navigating to /admin/inventory throws 'ReferenceError: TourInventoryManagement is not defined'. AdminDashboard.js imports { InventoryManagement } from '../components/admin' (barrel re-exports TourInventoryManagement as InventoryManagement), but Route element uses <TourInventoryManagement /> directly — identifier not in scope.
failed.evidence: src/pages/AdminDashboard.js:12 imports InventoryManagement; line 64: <Route path="inventory" element={<TourInventoryManagement />} />. Browser shows 'Uncaught runtime errors: TourInventoryManagement is not defined' at AdminDashboard (bundle.js:96148:95).

failed.issue: Backend was not running on load: supervisord was not up, python venv path mismatch (/root/.venv vs /root/venv), missing python deps (ujson/motor), and mongod was not started. Preview URL returned 502.
failed.evidence: pymongo ServerSelectionTimeoutError localhost:27017 refused; ModuleNotFoundError: ujson. Resolved by starting supervisord with corrected venv path, installing requirements.txt into /root/venv, starting mongod. Preview and local backend subsequently returned 200.

action_items: Fix AdminDashboard.js: either change <TourInventoryManagement /> to <InventoryManagement /> on line 64, or add `import TourInventoryManagement from '../components/admin/TourInventoryManagement';`
Rebuild/hot-reload will fix once import matches. Then retest /admin/inventory UI (fields EZ/DZ/Twin, save button, summary, persistence)
Confirm deployment plan: backend tour-inventory routes exist locally and are reachable via preview URL; still need Fly.io deployment for production
